author: KojaCola
body:
Application

Age: 15 almost 16

Timezone: EST

Do you have access to TeamSpeak? Yes/No: Yes, I also have a mic

Do you have access to Skype? Yes/No: Yes

Do you have access to a recording software? Yes/No: Yes


CRITERIA 1: SELF REFLECTION/EVALUATION


Do you have any experience as a staff member on any servers?


The only experience I have as staff member is being promoted to referee on Avicus, and being on the translation team of Hypixel.


What is your biggest weakness and how do you believe it will affect your moderating? What is your biggest strength and how would this affect your moderating?


My biggest weakness is being too much of a “hardass”. I always try to make sure people are following the rules, which makes others’ annoyed considering I am not a moderator, but I am willing to do what it takes to enforce the rules appropriately. My biggest strength is the amount of organization, discipline and care I put into my work. I am a very thorough person and am always there to finish a job I started. I complete my commitments, and finish my work with care and without question. This means that while moderating, I will bring discipline and organization to my work, and complete it with care. These are necessary skills when moderating.



How do you believe you can help improve the Staff Team?


I think the main way I can improve the Staff Team is with my responsibility and connection with the community. I notice many gaps where no staff are on, and I will strive to bridge those gaps and make sure all hackers are banned, and to make sure all players are following rules. I will also bring care and passion to the team. I am incredibly passionate about Avicus and as a staff member I will truly care about the team and about Avicus. I will also try my best to make sure the staff team becomes more active.


What qualities does a leader need to have in your opinion? Do you consider yourself to

be a leader? Why?


Some qualities a leader needs are patience, passion and care. First, leaders need patience to deal with possible situations that may cause others to be angry or inpatient. Patience also comes with maturity, and all leaders need high levels of patience. If leaders are not patient, there will be chaos, and unorganization. The second is passion and care. Leaders need to care about the team they lead, and must have a cause. Passion is probably the most important attribute a leader should have. To be a true leader, one must have passion for who and what they are leading. The last quality is maturity. All leaders need maturity when dealing with complex situations, as well as communicating well with other people. Maturity comes with both experience and care, both of which I have.



What attributes distinguish yourself from other players that qualify you to be a moderator?


Some qualities I distinguish myself by are responsible, reliable, and devoted. I am a very mature person and am very devoted to the server. I am on constantly, and am always striving to help the server as much as possible. Another attribute is consistency. Many overlook this attribute, but I think it is one of the most important. To be consistant comes with maturity and responsibility. I am consistent with the amount of hours I put onto Avicus, and am always guiding others on following rules and assisting them in any way possible. I also consistently upload evidence of players hacking or breaking rules.


What skills do you believe you should have when interacting with the community? Do you believe you have these skills?


When interacting with the community, patience, kindness and respect are necessary when interacting with a class knit community like Avicus. I do believe I have these skills and will implement them when interacting with the community. First, patience. Patience is needed in case someone is not breaking the rules but is annoying you, or being unkind. During these situations, maintaining a calm persona is necessary to set a good role model. Kindness is needed to keep the players of Avicus happy and have them enjoy the game as much as possible. The last skill is respect. Repsect is the ground rule for everything. With respect, you can learn more, be kind to others, and treat people, places and things with more kindness.



How much time can you commit to being a staff member (Rough Idea)?


I will commit at least 2-3 hours weekday, 3-4 weekend while a staff member. This can be seen with the amount of time I put in on Avicus.



CRITERIA 2: GENERAL SITUATIONS


You are currently undergoing your junior moderator trial. A ban evader is online and he is constantly ban evading and hacking. You are the only one online and the only one who is able to be online. What would you do?


The first thing I would do is to freeze him, then keep him frozen until he either leaves or staff member comes online. Then I would ping a mod to come online after evidence is recorded. I have seen this exact scenario actually take place multiple times, so I know how to handle the situation.



Another staff member is constantly joining and harassing other people on Teamspeak in their team channel. The staff member is also referee and has physical permissions to be in that channel. However the leaders do not want this staff member in there and they have asked him to leave multiple times. What would you do?


The first thing I would do is warn the staff member personally. If they do not respond or ignore the warn, I would record evidence, and then give evidence to higher ranking staff member to review and give necessary punishments.



A player appeals a punishment you gave them. You realise that the evidence file is corrupted and therefore there is no physical evidence. You know however this person did indeed break the rules, what would you do?


I would ask any other staff members if they have any evidence regarding the player. If not, I would be honest. I would tell the player what happened, and ask a higher ranking staff member what to do.



You are in an Avicus team. One of your teammates is also an Avicus Staff member. One day in your team discord the team member/staff member posts a screenshot of a thread that only staff members can see. The content in the screenshot isn’t very important/confident but only staff members could see it on the forums. If anything, what would you do?



I would put aside the personal connection I have with the player and immediately take a screenshot of it and send it to higher ranking staff members. Avicus as a whole is more important to me, and I would do what is necessary to help Avicus.


One day the Senior Staff team makes a decision you do not agree with. You do not know all the details of the decision or the circumstances in which they were made and you were simply told by another staff member. However you do not like the decision based from what you know. What would you do?


I would first try to gain as much information as possible. Since in this situation, I do not have all details, I would try to gather them first. Then, if I still disagree, I would make a suggestion to the Senior Staff team with lots of reasoning behind it.


CRITERIA 3: OTHER

NOTE: This is a new criteria and these questions are less to do with right/wrong answer and more to do with us getting to know you. Please answer these honestly. There is no right or wrong answer.



What would getting moderator on Avicus mean to you?


Avicus has been a home to me, and to have an opportunity to be on the moderating team means the world to me. To be a moderator on Avicus will mean that I know I am helping a cause I believe in as much as possible. I am very passionate about Avicus, and I know the dedication I will put in to moderating will be infinite.


How passionate are you about Avicus? What does Avicus mean to you?


Avicus has served as my home for the past two years. The community of Avicus is something that cannot be torn apart. No matter how many flame wars erupt, even if Avicus declines in popularity, the community will always be there. This is important to me because I have made many great friends through Avicus, and many who I will never forget. Avicus is special, and I have always appreciated the amount of support that the community gives you. Whether its help with homework, or you need life advice, for me, Avicus has always been the place to turn. As a person who tends not to ask for help, Avicus has been a really big help for me to build confidence. Avicus has always been a part of me, and always will be. I am willing to do anything for the community, and for Avicus. Whether that means putting hours into moderating, or “minimizing” or donating a dollar, I will always be there for Avicus, because it has always been there for me.



Do you speak any other languages than English?


I speak fluent Japanese, as well as good Mandarin.


Do you have anything else to add to your application?


Although I may not have the most experience being a staff member, I know I am a person who can grow, and who works well with a team. I have always been a team player, and will bring that to the moderating team. I know I am a person who is willing to learn, and help those in need. I have the skill set necessary to be a strong staff member, and hope you will see that. From what I see in myself, I think I will become a great moderator, and will bring a whole lot to the moderator team. The dedication and effort that I will put in will be infinite. I will take this role seriously, and will do the absolute best that I can for Avicus. Avicus has always been there for me, and I will always be there for it. I am new to the staff team, but I am extremely eager to learn as much as possible and do the best job that I can for the team, and Avicus. I will always do my best, and will strive to be a team player and bring the best I can to the staff team. The amount I care for Avicus cannot be stated in this application. I wish to do the best I can for Avicus, and I think becoming moderator will complete that goal. I have been active on Avicus for the past three years, and I am ready to become a full staff member. I have all of the necessary qualifications and I have the necessary attributes to become a moderator. I have been consistently helping moderators by “minimizing” and noting players of their breaking of the rules. I have also helped the staff team when there are no staff on, recording evidence, uploading it and doing my best to make sure other players don’t get impatient. I am always enthusiastic about clicking the join button of Avicus, and seeing which of my friends are on, or what new friends I can make. I also really enjoy “minimoding” and helping the staff. I always encourage others to check out the avicus home page, or help them with anything they might need. I'm willing to do anything for Avicus, and I can do the most for Avicus by becoming a moderator and filling in times when no moderators are on, as well as help grow the community, and keep it thriving. In short, I hope I conveyed my deep care and loyalty I have to this server. It means a lot to me, and I hope you see my passion. Thank you for reading my application, and thank you for giving me an opportunity to be a part of the moderating team.


Koja.
